summary: A structured frontend lab project demonstrating modern CSS architecture, responsive design patterns, and maintainable stylesheet practices.
key_features: Modular CSS organization by layout, component, and utility
Mobile-first responsive design with relative units (rem, %, vw/vh)
Strict cascade management to avoid specificity conflicts
Comprehensive inline documentation for design decisions
Automated validation and cross-browser testing workflow
achievements: Engineered a scalable and maintainable CSS architecture with logical grouping and low-specificity selectors, implemented responsive flexbox grids with precise breakpoint control, and established a standardized development pipeline featuring W3C validation, local server testing, and conventional Git commit practices.
